verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs state that it can resize and convert images on demand and serve them from its CDN in modern formats, which matches the story's core: on-demand resizing and optimization through a built-in image CDN. The support rests on a single one-line first-party mention, with no detail on how it works or what limits apply. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the image optimization API, supported transforms, formats and caching behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
